scope: Same-link map storage comparison only; no use ELF disassembly, optimization remarks or CPU attribution
matching: Exact full mangled symbol plus input-object basename; only .text.hot./.text.unlikely. placement prefixes removed. No crate-hash, LLVM clone, closure, generic-argument or instantiation identifiers removed. Display demangling does not define identity.

E.warning: Merged string/input sections overlap; do not sum input declarations or pair anonymous constant ordinals as semantic identities.

use.warning: Merged string/input sections overlap; do not sum input declarations or pair anonymous constant ordinals as semantic identities.

profile_match_rule: Exact mangled symbol after optional module-prefix semicolon; match only unique record, never combine ambiguity. Counter activity is from generate training, not timing.
